mapper.select: SELECT t1.plan_name as planName, t1.plan_type as planType, t1.plan_first_date as planFirstDate, t1.plan_number as planNumber, t1.duration as duration, t2.`name` as planTemplateName FROM bm_production_plan AS t1 JOIN bm_plan_template AS t2 ON t1.plan_template_id = t2.id WHERE t1.is_deleted = 0 AND t2.is_deleted = 0 AND t1.id =#{id}
